title: Danone North America, PBC — FDA Enforcement Intelligence
excerpt: Enforcement intelligence profile for Danone North America, covering 13 recall actions across its yogurt, dairy, plant-based, and coffee creamer portfolio. A pattern of foreign material contamination, undeclared allergens, and spoilage events — compounded by the 2026 global infant formula cereulide crisis — exposes systemic quality control gaps across one of the largest certified B Corporations in the United States.
seo_title: Danone FDA Recalls & Enforcement Actions | Policy Canary
seo_description: Complete enforcement intelligence on Danone North America: 13 FDA recall actions covering YoCrunch plastic contamination, International Delight spoilage, undeclared allergens, and the global infant formula cereulide crisis. Analysis of patterns, affected brands, and industry implications.

key_deadlines.description: FSMA Food Traceability Final Rule compliance date (extended from January 2026) — impacts Danone's dairy, plant-based, and yogurt supply chains
